the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(g):
    bg = Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,r in enumerate(out):
        # first anomaly column in this row
        cols=[j for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=bg]
        if not cols: continue
        j0=cols[0]
        m=r[j0]
        for k in range(j0+1,len(r)):
            out[i][k]=5 if (k-j0)%2==1 else m
    return out
